en: A black‑and‑white photograph showing a small wooden bridge over a fast‑flowing river or weir in a forested, rocky gorge. Water cascades beneath the bridge, creating white foam in the foreground. Tall coniferous trees rise behind the rocks. On the rock face to the right, a handwritten word is visible. The overall look is of an early 20th‑century landscape postcard.
